# Hornero OS

> Pre-release Arch Linux desktop: Hyprland + Quickshell shell, one CLI (`horneroctl`), pinned compositions.

## Status

HorneroOS is pre-release. There is no ISO and no guided installer yet. On Arch today: install `horneroctl-bin` from the AUR.

- Docs: https://github.com/HorneroOS/docs
- Composition: https://github.com/HorneroOS/hornero
- Shell: https://github.com/HorneroOS/shell
- Installer contract: https://github.com/HorneroOS/installer

## Pages

- `/` — what Hornero OS is
- `/install` — install profiles and requirements
- `/roots` — where each piece comes from
- `/showroom` — desktop captures (provenance per caption)
